idea.name: The Attention Seeker: organic-only social media agency

key_quotes.quote: And and our whole like I guess philosophy is first we do it for ourselves and then we prove it and then we do it for clients.
Like where our whole pitch to people is now I can get you 5 million views a month just by posting it.
And so our whole approach to that is just create what we call a social TV show as like a base layer.

claims.quote: We thought we do 20, 30 grand in first month, and first month was 150.

claims.quote: So we're we're purely personal branding on LinkedIn for first three years of the business and we got to about 15 staff at that point.

claims.claim: Shrunk from 40 to 15 staff via AI with more revenue
